weekly_theme.summary: 太陽剛進入天秤座不久，生活重心可能悄悄轉往天秤座相關的主題與氣氛。

aries.horoscope: 今天對你來說就是享受和輕鬆，白羊座。現在不是處理待辦事項清單的最佳時機。無論你多麼努力地集中注意力，周圍都會出現幹擾。你的電郵夥伴會分享一些歡笑，而你的朋友則會邀請你出去玩。擁抱這一刻，放縱自己！
aries.horoscope_en: Today is all about enjoyment and lightheartedness for you, Aries. It's not the best time for tackling your to-do list. No matter how hard you try to concentrate, distractions will be popping up all around you. Expect your email buddies to share some laughs and your friends to invite you out for some fun. Embrace the moment and let yourself indulge!

taurus.horoscope_en: Today, Taurus, your diverse skills may lead you to uncover yet another hidden talent. The arrival of a new gadget will feel like a delightful gift just for you. However, once you’ve set up your new device, don’t keep it to yourself! Share it with your colleagues, as they will surely be amazed by your technical prowess.

gemini.horoscope_en: Today, you might find yourself inundated with messages from friends and colleagues eager to seek your wisdom, Gemini. Your insights are in high demand, and while it's nice to be in the spotlight, it could hinder your productivity. Offer assistance to your teammates, but don’t hesitate to set boundaries by letting them know that your availability is limited. Prioritize wrapping up early so you can enjoy quality time with your loved ones.

cancer.horoscope_en: Cancer, it's important to stand your ground and not be swayed by friends who may be overly dependent on you. The current cosmic influences encourage you to establish firm boundaries. Reflect on which friends truly support and uplift you versus those who seem to sap your energy with their incessant demands for your time. Don't hesitate to decline their requests. Remember, you aren't responsible for solving their problems. Take a moment to consider this.

leo.horoscope_en: Today is perfect for connecting with friends and colleagues, Leo. The atmosphere is light and social, making it a great time to enjoy each other's company rather than focusing on work. Embrace this playful energy and take a break from any work-related stress. You can always return to your tasks later; they will still be waiting for you.

virgo.horoscope_en: Today marks a significant advancement in your technical abilities, Virgo. It appears that all the hard work and training you've invested is starting to yield results. Any action you take will lead to positive outcomes.

While reconnecting with familiar faces can be enjoyable, it can also feel a bit intimidating to rekindle old friendships and keep up with new ones. Remember to pause and take a deep breath; you're navigating this just fine.

sagittarius.horoscope_en: Sagittarius, your recent discussions may have included individuals from the healing fields. Additionally, anticipate some positive developments regarding your financial situation.

capricorn.horoscope_en: Today, Capricorn, you might stumble upon a hidden skill that surprises you. It could be that a new piece of equipment at work is calling your name, and you're the one who can master it. Alternatively, as you put together a straightforward business proposal, you may find a newfound passion for writing. This day is perfect for unleashing your creativity and tackling any paperwork that comes your way. Wrap up your tasks so you can savor a relaxing evening.

If you hesitate, someone else might take advantage of the chance.

All the effort you've put in recently is starting to pay off, and the acknowledgment you've received is boosting your self-esteem significantly.
